induction' k with k IH
· intro n
  rw [nat.choose_zero, one_pow, div_one]
  exact (hr (n + 1)).continuous_at (by simp)
· have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
  have h': Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhvs (r^k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    by {
      let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
      let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
      have hg : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := h
      have hf : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhvs (r^k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
        by {
          apply tendsto.prod
          · exact (tendsto.pow hg (by exact nat.cast_pos k))
          · exact (tendsto.mul_left hg (by exact (tendsto.const_nhds (↑k.factorial) (by exact rfl))))
        }
      exact hf
    }
  exact h'
